channel.title: Kamlesh Bhagatkar: articles
channel.description: Geopolitics and current affairs from Nagpur, by author and geopolitical analyst Kamlesh Bhagatkar.

item.title: The Train Reaches Rowghat: What a 95-km Line Means for Bastar
item.description: The Dalli-Rajhara-Rowghat railway line is complete after more than a decade of Maoist opposition. Here is what it carries, and what Bastar still needs.

item.title: Inflation Crosses 6 Per Cent: What October's Numbers Tell Us
item.description: Retail inflation rose to 6.09 per cent in October, above the RBI's upper limit, as food inflation hit 8.94 per cent. The RBI meets on 2 December.

item.title: Modi Goes to Manila: Trade, Myanmar and an Unconfirmed Quad
item.description: Modi attends the ASEAN-India and East Asia summits in Manila from 16 November. A Quad meeting is likely but unconfirmed. Trade is the harder test.

item.title: Jaishankar Says the China Border Is "More Alive". He Is Right
item.description: Jaishankar says the China border now needs a much larger standing troop presence. The Arunachal face-offs show why the thaw has not changed the ground.

item.title: Goyal Promises "One of the Best" US Trade Deals. Here Is the Test
item.description: Piyush Goyal says India will get one of the best US trade deals. The real test is how our tariff compares with Vietnam's and Bangladesh's.

item.title: A Trump-Xi-Putin Meeting in Shenzhen? What Bharat Should Watch
item.description: Washington says peace and denuclearisation could come up at a possible US-China-Russia leaders' meeting next week. India will not be at that table.

item.title: India's Black Sea Ideas: A Practical Offer in the Ukraine War
item.description: After Modi spoke to Zelenskyy and Jaishankar to Lavrov, New Delhi says it has shared ideas on Black Sea shipping, grain and energy.

item.title: Diwali Needs No Translation, Mr Kharge
item.description: Kharge called Diwali an "Eid of happiness". The BJP saw appeasement, and Congress answered with insults. I think Congress keeps misreading Hindu sentiment.

item.title: Hormuz Is Burning, and India's Oil Still Flows. Here Is Why
item.description: As tankers burn in the Strait of Hormuz, Indian Oil's numbers show how India spread its risk: 55 per cent Russian crude and fuller stocks.

item.title: India and the EU Clear the Desk Before Brussels
item.description: The 7th India-EU review in New Delhi shows what is settled before the December trade deal signing, and what still is not.

item.title: Cheaper Cancer Medicines from Today: What Changed and What to Check
item.description: Revised MRPs for 1,364 anti-cancer formulations took effect on 9 November. The government puts consumer savings at Rs 3,540.38 crore a year.

item.title: Watching the World from the Centre of India
item.description: Why geopolitics matters to anyone who runs a business, buys petrol or has a child in the army.

item.title: Nineteen Days: What Operation Sindoor Changed for India
item.description: Terror now has an address and a price. Four lessons from the nineteen days between Pahalgam and the ceasefire.

item.title: A Hundred Years of Sewa: What I Learnt Writing About the RSS
item.description: How an organisation with no salaries and no glamour kept going for a century.
